run_encoder_analysis: run the encoder analysis tool to compute cross-lingual sentence retrieval accuracy for a directory of embeddings
compute_dist_neighbors: compute cosine similarity between source and target sentence embeddings and return top-k nearest neighbors
load_embeddings_multi_lang: load sentence embeddings and texts from binary shard files across multiple language directories
compute_accuracy_cross_lingual: compute top-1 and top-5 cross-lingual sentence retrieval accuracy across all language pairs
summarize_encoder_outputs: summarize encoder outputs by analyzing sentence embedding similarity across language pairs
